issue.title: Use after free with mbedTLS
issue.body:
## Title

`SSLClient::~SSLClient` frees TLS context before `close_notify` (UAF with mbedTLS keep-alive)

Reproducer:
https://github.com/daveisfera/cpp-httplib-sslclient-dtor-uaf

## Summary

With `CPPHTTPLIB_MBEDTLS_SUPPORT`, destroying an `SSLClient` that still has a
live keep-alive session use-after-frees the mbedTLS `mbedtls_ssl_config`
(`conf`).

`~SSLClient` currently does (v0.47.0 and current `master`):

```cpp
inline SSLClient::~SSLClient() {
  if (ctx_) { tls::free_context(ctx_); }   // delete MbedTlsContext → mbedtls_ssl_config_free
  shutdown_ssl_impl(socket_, true);         // mbedtls_ssl_close_notify still uses ssl->conf
}
```

`mbedtls_ssl_setup(&ssl, &ctx->conf)` binds the session to that config by
pointer (not by owning/refcount). `tls::shutdown` then calls
`mbedtls_ssl_close_notify`, which reads through the freed `conf`.

## ASan stack (from the attached repro)

```
ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free
READ of size 8
    #0 mbedtls_debug_print_msg          (or mbedtls_ssl_write_record if DEBUG_C is off)
    #1 mbedtls_ssl_close_notify
    #2 httplib::tls::shutdown
    #3 httplib::SSLClient::shutdown_ssl_impl
    #4 httplib::SSLClient::~SSLClient

freed by:
    #0 operator delete
    #1 httplib::tls::free_context
    #2 httplib::SSLClient::~SSLClient

previously allocated by:
    #0 operator new
    #1 httplib::tls::create_client_context
    #2 httplib::SSLClient::init_ctx / SSLClient::SSLClient
```

## Why OpenSSL often looks fine

The OpenSSL backend’s `free_context` is `SSL_CTX_free`. `SSL` holds a
reference on `SSL_CTX`, so freeing the context first only drops a refcount;
the real free happens later in `free_session` / `SSL_free`. mbedTLS does not
get that safety net: `free_context` immediately `delete`s the context object
that owns `conf`. The same destructor order is used for wolfSSL.

## Suggested fix

Shut down / free the session before freeing the context:

```cpp
inline SSLClient::~SSLClient() {
  shutdown_ssl_impl(socket_, true);
  if (ctx_) {
    tls::free_context(ctx_);
    ctx_ = nullptr;
  }
}
```

(Keep calling `shutdown_ssl_impl` from `~SSLClient` so SSL cleanup still
happens; `ClientImpl`’s virtual `shutdown_ssl` will not dispatch once the
derived destructor has finished.)

## Reproducer

```sh
./run.sh
```

Builds mbedTLS 3.6 with ASan, compiles a tiny keep-alive `SSLClient` +
in-process `SSLServer`, and expects ASan to abort on destructor teardown.

Single-threaded is enough. Without ASan, the UAF is often silent until heap
reuse (more likely with several short-lived clients).

Note: ASan must instrument mbedTLS itself. Linking an ASan binary against a
distro `libmbedtls.so` will not reliably detect the read inside
`mbedtls_ssl_close_notify`.

## Environment where we hit it in production

- cpp-httplib v0.47.0 (`CPPHTTPLIB_MBEDTLS_SUPPORT`)
- mbedTLS 3.6 (Alpine 3.23 packages)
- Static musl `linux/arm/v7` under qemu-user → SIGSEGV in
  `mbedtls_ssl_close_notify` / `mbedtls_ssl_write_record`
- Multiple short-lived `SSLClient`s with keep-alive (upload + health check)

## Related code

- `SSLClient::~SSLClient` — frees `ctx_` then `shutdown_ssl_impl`
- mbedTLS `tls::free_context` → `delete MbedTlsContext` → `mbedtls_ssl_config_free(&conf)`
- mbedTLS `tls::shutdown` → `mbedtls_ssl_close_notify`
- `mbedtls_ssl_setup(&session->ssl, &mctx->conf)` — session borrows `conf`
